what: Menu text is stacked in two copies. On hover the front copy fades out in .2s while moving up 30px over .9s, and the back copy fades in over .2s from 30px below and rises into place over .9s — the fade is short and the move long, so the text swaps without afterimage (a swap, not a roll). If a different color is given to the back copy, the color changes as it rises.

options.[data-fx-part=next]: Back copy of the text (child, aria-hidden) — same text. If given another color, it rises in that color (the Brand phone menu panel is beige)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Move duration and curve, default .9s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)
options.--fx-fade · --fx-fade-ease: On/off length and curve, default .2s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1)
options.look: deep: It spins with a hand anywhere over the wrapping link or button, not just the direct parent, for when the whole band is a link and the text sits deep inside (Brand ENTRY band). Giving --fx-shift a negative value reverses it (front set goes down, back set comes from above)

from.where: shared.css .nt-roll (header · hero left · footer · phone menu panel links) — original studio link inside an overflow clip: front box opacity 200ms + text translate −30px 900ms cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), back box (absolute) opacity 0→1 200ms + text translate 30px→0 900ms
All pages except index.html .nj-link · .nj-header__cvLink · .nj-btn · .mv__navLink (--fx-shift 100% · --fx-dur .5s · --fx-ease cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1) · --fx-fade .5s linear)

shared.css .cp-entry__title — original .entry:hover .before-text translateY(100%)·opacity 0 / .after-text -100% → 0, both .4s ease (look: deep · --fx-shift -100% · --fx-dur .4s ease · --fx-fade .4s ease)

note: Spins when you hover the parent link or button (used wrapped inside a link). Same reaction on keyboard focus (focus-visible)
